title: Plan: revalidate ffn_down_exps with Q8_0 CPU-compatible arithmetic

motivation.previous_down_result: blk.0.ffn_down_exps.weight output-write max_calls=64 failed with same_top1=143/145 and first_mismatch_pos=109.
motivation.why_revisit: That rejection happened before the CPU-compatible Q8_0 arithmetic fixed the up boundary and full all-up top1. Down may have failed for the same arithmetic-order reason.
motivation.why_correctness_first: 10 tok/s requires removing or reducing both up and down fallback, but no down performance work is allowed until token-level correctness is proven.

source_change_plan.behavior: When unset, q80 write/skip remains restricted to ffn_up_exps exactly as current accepted source. When set, q80 write/skip name filters may also match ffn_down_exps.
source_change_plan.validation_before_down_test: Build llama-cli and llama-results, then run default-off fixed-text top1 sanity to ensure accepted/default behavior is unchanged.

first_runtime_gate.type: output-write correctness only; CPU fallback still runs first and CUDA overwrites dst
first_runtime_gate.command: llama-results fixed-text top1 check against the existing baseline result.gguf under 16GB/no-swap cgroup
first_runtime_gate.pass_condition: llama-results exits 0, same_top1 == n_tokens, first_mismatch_pos == -1, max_abs == 0, mean_abs == 0
first_runtime_gate.failure_rule: If output-write fails, do not run down skip and keep down disabled except for rejected artifacts.

promotion_rule: No performance benchmark may be run from this plan. Passing down output-write only permits a later down skip correctness plan.
